taxonomy_basis: Seven independent trigger semantics for the five finalized physical roots, derived from the frozen DUT README (sha256 01ae027c487a9e16a64c65cee2c91b306f03534c69a81a7769f8d1bcec3d328d) and same-revision reproduced cases; independent semantic review remains required

scenarios.name: shared buffer value sampled on clock advance
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 146-153: shared buffers store intermediate values and flip-flops update synchronously on clk

scenarios.name: AGU add isolated from inactive AGU operations
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 43-54 and 130-138: AGU operation selects identify distinct add/logic/min/max/swap operations

scenarios.name: ALU LUI isolated from inactive ALU operations
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 19-32 and 118-124: ALU request selects identify distinct arithmetic, logic, shift, compare and LUI operations

scenarios.name: concurrent AGU and MULDIV request with shared buffer activity
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 73-88 and 140-147: optional MULDIV and AGU share arithmetic resources and two intermediate-result buffers

scenarios.name: BJP addition isolated from comparison selection
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 33-42 and 125-129: BJP exposes a distinct addition result and comparison result

scenarios.name: BJP unsigned greater-than with equal operands
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 36-41 and 125-128: BJP supports distinct unsigned greater-than comparison

scenarios.name: BJP signed greater-than with equal operands
scenarios.spec_citation: Frozen e203_exu_alu_dpath README lines 36-41 and 125-128: BJP supports distinct signed greater-than comparison
